productOnPage.description: Yoto Says: Join Bab Sharkey for four bonkers Egyptian adventures packed with ancient magic, mummy madness, and big laughs. Head to Egypt in the hilarious Bab Sharkey and the Animal Mummies adventure series, from the bonkers brains of award-winning Australian comedian Andrew Hansen and Jessica Roberts. Titles included: ﻿1. Bab Sharkey and the Animal Mummies: The Weird Beard When twelve-year-old Bab Sharkey finds a magical beard in the Egyptian desert, it attaches itself to his face, making him the Pharaoh and granting him strange powers. Bab also finds the friends he’s always needed: a pair of undead animals wrapped in bandages called Scaler the Fish Mummy and Prong the Ibis Mummy. But the previous owner of the Beard, the ancient and evil sorceress the Unpharaoh, is determined to get it back. Can Bab and his new Animal Mummy friends banish the Unpharaoh back to the Afterworld? 2. Bab Sharkey and the Animal Mummies: The Giant Moth Mummy A dark river under the world. An Ibis Mummy with an upside-down head. And the whole of Mumphis in peril… from six talking shoes. Boy Pharaoh Bab Sharkey returns to the magic city of the Animal Mummies. Only this time, he faces the grossest weapon ever devised – a giant mummified moth possessed by the spirit of the Unpharaoh herself! Can Bab and his smelly friends defeat this ancient evil? 3. Bab Sharkey and the Animal Mummies: The Spongy Void A mummified chunk of brain. A Fish Mummy sucked down a garbage chute. And a chamber of purple magic … that absorbs people like a sponge! On a rescue mission, boy Pharaoh Bab Sharkey becomes trapped in Egypt’s greatest pyramid. What is the terrible truth about the Unpharaoh’s past? Can Bab unearth the secrets of the Spongy Void? And will Prong and Scaler be thrown into a mummy museum forever? 4. Bab Sharkey and the Animal Mummies: The Prickly Battle The Unpharaoh is resurrected once again – this time in the form of an evil beard! With Bab’s pharaoh beard destroyed, he’ll have to team up with Prong, Scaler and the Animal Mummies to stop the Unpharaoh once and for all. Tracks included: Intro Credits Warning Chapter 1: The Unpharaoh Chapter 2: Strange Things in the Desert Chapter 3: The Dark Store Room Chapter 4: Night Monsters Chapter 5: Prong and Scalar Chapter 6: Dragged by the Beard Chapter 7: Welcome to Mumphis Chapter 8: Scaler's Story Chapter 9: Pharaoh Bab Chapter 10: The Tomb of the Jackals Chapter 11: Walking in Mumphis Chapter 12: A Stranger at the Gate Chapter 13: Dust Burgers Chapter 14: Cainus the Waiter Chapter 15: The smoothie of Immortality Chapter 16: Return of the Unpharaoh Chapter 17: Chaos in Mumphis Chapter 18: The Jackal Party Chapter 19: Stupid Fluff Chapter 20: The Unpharaoh's Tomb Chapter 21: The Beard Boulder Chapter 22: Bab the Embalmer Chapter 23: A Boot for Cainus Chapter 24: So Long, Mumphis Chapter 25: So Long, Beard Coming Soon End Credits

Titles included: ﻿  
  
1. Bab Sharkey and the Animal Mummies: The Weird Beard   
  
When twelve-year-old Bab Sharkey finds a magical beard in the Egyptian desert, it attaches itself to his face, making him the Pharaoh and granting him strange powers. Can Bab and his new Animal Mummy friends banish the Unpharaoh back to the Afterworld?   
  
  
  
  
2. Bab Sharkey and the Animal Mummies: The Giant Moth Mummy   
  
A dark river under the world. An Ibis Mummy with an upside-down head. And the whole of Mumphis in peril… from six talking shoes. Boy Pharaoh Bab Sharkey returns to the magic city of the Animal Mummies. Only this time, he faces the grossest weapon ever devised – a giant mummified moth possessed by the spirit of the Unpharaoh herself! Can Bab and his smelly friends defeat this ancient evil?   
  
  
  
  
3. Bab Sharkey and the Animal Mummies: The Spongy Void   
  
A mummified chunk of brain. A Fish Mummy sucked down a garbage chute. And a chamber of purple magic … that absorbs people like a sponge! On a rescue mission, boy Pharaoh Bab Sharkey becomes trapped in Egypt’s greatest pyramid. What is the terrible truth about the Unpharaoh’s past? Can Bab unearth the secrets of the Spongy Void? And will Prong and Scaler be thrown into a mummy museum forever?
